Telegrive now runs on a Mac, with your drive in Finder and folders that sync by themselves. Phones get private folders, album and folder uploads, a pause for photo backup, and a round of fixes.

More about it, and step-by-step install guides, at https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/

## Which file to download

- **Mac:** `telegrive-1.1.0-macos.dmg`, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 12 or newer. See [Opening it on a Mac](#opening-it-on-a-mac) below.
- **Android, most phones:** `telegrive-1.1.0-arm64-v8a.apk`
- **Android, older phones:** `telegrive-1.1.0-armeabi-v7a.apk`
- **Chromebooks and emulators:** `telegrive-1.1.0-x86_64.apk`
- **iPhone:** `telegrive-1.1.0.ipa`, installed with Sideloadly, SideStore or AltStore and your own Apple Account. Follow the [iPhone guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/iphone.html); it shows every step.

On Android, the new APK installs over 1.0.0. `telegrive-1.1.0.aab` is the same Android app as a bundle for app stores; you don't need it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.

Windows and Linux are on their way, and will be added to this release once they're tested.

## Opening it on a Mac

Open the disk image and drag Telegrive onto Applications. Apple hasn't checked the app, so your Mac won't open it straight away the first time. The quickest way through is to paste this into Terminal and press Return:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Telegrive.app
```

Then open Telegrive from Applications. Without Terminal, open it once, click Done, and click Open Anyway in System Settings › Privacy & Security; the [Mac guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/mac.html) shows each step.

## On a Mac

- **Sign in with a QR code.** Telegrive opens on one, ready to scan with Telegram on your phone. Your phone number works too.
- **Your drive in Finder.** Settings › Show the drive in Finder adds it as a disk, so any app can open files from it, save into it, and drag files to it.
- **Folder sync.** Choose folders on your Mac, and whatever is saved in them goes up to the drive a minute later.
- **Drag files and folders onto the window** to upload them, and choose the folder downloads go to.
- **Made for a mouse and keyboard:** a sidebar, Files as a table, click to select and double-click to open, Cmd-Z to undo, and a menu bar with the keys a Mac app has.
- **Keeps running in the menu bar** when you close the window, opens at login if you like, and keeps the Mac awake while files transfer. The Dock icon counts what's under way.
- **Videos play in the app**, MKV and HEVC included, or open in IINA, VLC or mpv without downloading first. HEIC, AVIF and RAW photos show as well.
- **App lock and Private** use Touch ID or your Mac's password.

Photo backup is for phones; on a Mac, Folder sync does that job.

## On your phone

- **Private folders.** Hide a folder from Photos, or keep it in Private, behind your phone's fingerprint, face or screen lock.
- **Upload an album** from your gallery, or **a whole folder** with the folders inside it. Photos and videos you pick keep their date taken.
- **Pause photo backup** for an hour, until tomorrow, or until you resume it.
- **Watched folders** say what stayed on the phone and why, and you choose whether each one shows in Photos.
- **Photos** shows all, only photos or only videos, newest or oldest first. Swipe through the photos of a folder, and pinch to zoom. RAW photos get previews.
- **Play in another app:** a video or song streams to the player you pick.
- **Make previews**, in Check my drive, gives photos and videos that have no preview one each, on mobile data too if you say so.
- **Search the forwarded files** before you move or keep them, and a setting keeps Recent and Continue playing off Home.

## Fixes

- On iPhone, the copies made of photos and picked files are deleted once they're sent, so Telegrive no longer fills up the phone's storage.
- Rebuild index is much faster on a large drive.
- Reading the drive finds every file. On some phones part of the drive was missing, and Check my drive reported parts missing that weren't.
- Check my drive answers sooner, and a file Telegram doesn't send no longer stops Make previews.
- If you sign in to the wrong account, you can go back and start over.
- When the app can't start, it says why instead of loading for ever.

## Support

Telegrive is free, with no ads. If it's useful to you, you can [send a tip on Jami](https://jami.bio/daveragoose). If something doesn't work, [report a problem](https://github.com/daveragos/telegrive/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
